messages:
Sofia: Hey team — we need to lock a time for the Nimbus Corp private/on‑prem deployment review. Can folks react or reply with preferred slots? Options (PST):
1) Tue 2026-04-07 09:00–09:45 PST
2) Tue 2026-04-07 11:30–12:15 PST
3) Wed 2026-04-08 08:00–08:45 PST

Agenda (proposed):
- Customer network & firewall validation (Tariq)
- Dedicated capacity sizing and autoscale plan (Sofia)
- Certificate/KMS/HSM checks + last-mile connectivity (Anya)
- Rollout / canary plan + fallback (Lia)
- Action items and smoke test signoff

Quick asks before the call: please drop the latest subnet/IP list, the runbook link, and any config diffs. React with :one:/:two:/:three: for slot preference.

Matt: Option 2 is best for me but I have a 12:00 conflict right after. If we can start at 11:20 that helps.

Anya: I can do 1 or 3. I’ll own cert/KMS checklist. I’ll prep a short runbook excerpt.

Tariq: Option 3 works better for SRE oncall. Also need customer CIDR + NAT/Gateway IPs before the call. Quick sanity check command folks can run on their gateway:```bash
# check upstream reachability from customer box
curl -sS --connect-timeout 5 https://status.redwood.ai || echo "reachability fail"
```
Please paste the CIDR(s) in thread.

deploy-bot: Meeting draft created: Nimbus Private Preflight — Tentative 2026-04-07 11:30 PST (will update when slot confirmed) :calendar:

Lia: Prefer option 1 but can flex. Also add a line item for canary rollout targets (qps, latency SLOs) and fallback model variant mapping.

Sofia: Thanks — sounds like 2 favoured but some conflicts. Proposal: lock 11:30 PST (option 2) and start at 11:20 to accommodate Matt. Final invite to go out once confirm from Tariq for oncall.
Agenda (final draft):
- 11:20 start — 5m quick intros and scope
- 11:25 network & firewall review (Tariq)
- 11:35 capacity & autoscale plan (Sofia)
- 11:45 certs/KMS/HSM checklist (Anya)
- 11:55 canary + fallback plan (Lia)
- 12:05 actions & signoff

Pre-reads: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nimbus-preflight (please pull latest)
Config diff: drive://nimbus/config_diff_20260401.patch
Run a quick inspect before the call:```bash
redwoodctl inspect nimbus --env prod --summary
```

Matt: uploaded the config diff to the drive link above, added notes about nginx upstream IPs.

Anya: I put the cert checklist here: drive://nimbus/certs_checklist.md — I’ll paste critical items in thread before EOD.

Sofia: Final checklist to bring to meeting: audit log access, customer CIDR + NAT IPs, cert chain + expiry, KMS key ARNs, HSM enrollment status, and the latest smoke test tickets. If anyone needs another slot, shout now. Otherwise I’ll send the calendar invite for Tue 2026-04-07 11:20–12:15 PST. :thumbsup:
